meta.description: Receives a finished inbound or outbound call (from the Calls page or a phone system), finds or creates the patient, writes the call, and logs call.completed or call.missed. See /docs/N8N_WORKFLOWS.md.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ organization_id: $json.organization_id, patient_id: $json.patient_id, direction: $json.direction, status: $json.status, phone_number: $json.phone, started_at: $json.started_at, duration_seconds: $json.duration_seconds, intent: $json.intent, outcome: $json.outcome, ai_handled: $json.ai_handled === true, ai_summary: $json.notes, transcript: $json.transcript || null }) }}

parameters.name: payload
parameters.value: ={{ { patient_name: $('Normalize Call').item.json.caller_name, direction: $json.body[0].direction, phone_number: $json.body[0].phone_number, status: $json.body[0].status, call_id: $json.body[0].id } }}
